title: Update systemd-boot EFI binary
summary: Updates the installed systemd-boot EFI binary on the ESP to match the version in the systemd package. This is often done automatically but can be triggered manually.

steps.explain: Run bootctl update to copy the new EFI binary from /usr/lib/systemd/boot/efi/ to the ESP.
steps.expect: Command completes without errors. It may report that the boot manager is already up to date.

rollback.explain: Reinstall the previous version of systemd-boot if the update caused issues. This usually requires booting from a live USB and chrooting, or using a previous backup if available.

warnings: If Secure Boot is enabled, the new binary must be signed. Unsigned binaries will fail to boot.
Ensure the ESP is mounted correctly before running the update.
